_comment: Provider template — Qwen3 via Alibaba Cloud Token Plan (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/claude-code). EXAMPLE of a user-authored provider extension: copy this file to profiles/<name>.json, set routing + <UPPERCASE-NAME>_ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (convention; override via the template's optional `_token_env`); no code change. See install.md. ADR #40. Sanitized copy of parallel-development's profiles/qwen.json (CSR-I3 substrate — rule 7 copy-pattern). EXTERNAL-HARNESS OPT-IN: substrate claude-code (Anthropic-compatible repointing via the Claude Code CLI). No placeholder default exists — unarmed = fail-fast arming prompt. PROFILE NAME is version-free (qwen); the pinned model alias lives in the env block below and is editable per generation. CREDENTIAL (SHARED-ENV ALIGNMENT 2026-08-25, ADR #54): `_token_env` points at the CC-convention var QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_CN_ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN from the one shared .env.solidforge — the SAME var the dsh-substrate qwen-token-plan-cn.json now declares via `_credential_env` (same endpoint, one credential, one var). This claude-code substrate reads ONLY `_token_env`.
